N001.summary: At the start of the game, you have limited information about the opponent's intentions. Your own economy, production, and technology are all in early development stages. Maintain a balanced development path, focusing on economy and production while keeping safety checks in mind. Avoid overcommitting to any single strategy until you have more information.
N001.title: Early Game Foundation
N001.trigger_summary: At the start of the game, you have limited information about the opponent's intentions. Your own economy, production, and technology are all in early development stages.

N002.summary: As the game progresses into the early-midgame, you still have limited information about the opponent, but you may have some scouting data. Your own economy and production remain light or uncertain. Maintain a balanced development path, but start to lean towards a ground-based army composition. Keep your options open for tech switches if needed. Continue to develop with safety checks.
N002.title: Early-Midgame Adaptation
N002.trigger_summary: As the game progresses into the early-midgame, you still have limited information about the opponent, but you may have some scouting data. Your own economy and production remain light or uncertain.

N003.summary: In the midgame, you have more information about the opponent's strategy, but your own posture is still light or uncertain. You need to consolidate your position and prepare for the midgame conflicts. Maintain a balanced development path, but start to solidify your army composition and tech choices. Continue to develop with safety checks, ensuring you have defenses against potential attacks.
N003.title: Midgame Consolidation
N003.trigger_summary: In the midgame, you have more information about the opponent's strategy, but your own posture is still light or uncertain. You need to consolidate your position and prepare for the midgame conflicts.

N004.summary: In the late-midgame, you have a good understanding of the opponent's strategy, and you need to prepare for the transition to the lategame. Your own posture is still light or uncertain, but you have a foundation to build upon. Maintain a balanced development path, but start to make concrete plans for the lategame. Consider transitioning to a composition that can counter the opponent's likely lategame army. Continue to develop with safety checks.
N004.title: Late-Midgame Preparation
N004.trigger_summary: In the late-midgame, you have a good understanding of the opponent's strategy, and you need to prepare for the transition to the lategame. Your own posture is still light or uncertain, but you have a foundation to build upon.
